VR.title: Canon Reveals Concept Handheld MR Device, Glass Waveguide & Collaboration Software
VR.summary: Canon showcased a concept handheld mixed reality device and new XR collaboration software at the Augmented World Expo, marking significant advancements in XR technology.

VR.title: XREAL AURA AR Glasses Get Fall Release Window, $1,500 Price Ceiling
VR.summary: XREAL AURA AR glasses, developed with Google and Qualcomm, are set to launch this fall with a price not exceeding $1,500.

VR.title: Qualcomm Announces Snapdragon Reality Elite, Its New Flagship XR Chipset
VR.summary: Qualcomm unveiled its Snapdragon Reality Elite chipset, aimed at enhancing the performance and compactness of future XR headsets and glasses.

VR.title: Xreal Aura Ships This Fall, With Snapdragon Reality Elite In Its Puck
VR.summary: Preorders for Xreal Aura have begun, featuring Qualcomm's Snapdragon Reality Elite in its compute puck, with a fall launch planned.

VR.title: Raven Prism Smart Glasses Announced with Unique Hot-swappable Battery
VR.summary: Raven Resonance announced its Raven Prism smart glasses, featuring a unique hot-swappable battery system, at the Augmented World Expo.

VR.title: Meta Opening Quest & Smart Glasses Demo Section In 50 Best Buys
VR.summary: Meta is launching a demo section for its Quest headsets and smart glasses in 50 Best Buy stores across the US and Canada.

AI.title: Photoshop and Premiere now have AI assistants
AI.summary: Adobe is rolling out AI assistants in Photoshop and Premiere as part of its plan to integrate AI across its Creative Cloud suite.

AI.title: Midjourney goes from generating cat images to full-body ultrasound scans
AI.summary: Midjourney introduced its first hardware product, a full-body ultrasound scanner, expanding its capabilities beyond AI image generation.

AI.title: Apple patches high-severity eavesdropping vulnerability in Beats Studio Buds
AI.summary: Apple has patched a significant eavesdropping vulnerability affecting Beats Studio Buds, addressing a flaw disclosed a year ago.

AI.title: Anthropic got hit by export rules nobody understands
AI.summary: Anthropic is grappling with export restrictions that have disrupted access to its latest AI models, impacting its operations significantly.

AI.title: Two-thirds of Americans think AI is advancing too quickly
AI.summary: A Pew Research poll reveals that two-thirds of Americans believe AI is advancing too quickly, despite increased usage of chatbots.

AI.title: Massive breach spills credentials for thousands of sensitive networks
AI.summary: A massive data breach has exposed credentials for numerous sensitive networks, including those of Oracle and FedEx.

NFL.title: Chargers sign fourth-round WR Brenen Thompson, complete draft class signings
NFL.summary: The Chargers have signed fourth-round wide receiver Brenen Thompson, completing their draft class signings.

NFL.title: Cowboys agree to sign DE Charles Snowden
NFL.summary: The Cowboys have agreed to sign defensive end Charles Snowden, bolstering their roster ahead of the upcoming season.

NFL.title: Mark Ingram, Terron Armstead to be inducted into Saints Hall of Fame
NFL.summary: Mark Ingram and Terron Armstead will be inducted into the Saints Hall of Fame during the 2026 season.

NFL.title: Report: Mike Pennel knew woman whose body was found on his property
NFL.summary: Free-agent defensive lineman Mike Pennel is under investigation related to the discovery of a woman's body on his former property.

NFL.title: With season approaching, "nothing is imminent" as to new NFL broadcast deals
NFL.summary: Negotiations for new NFL broadcast deals are ongoing, with no imminent changes expected before the 2026 season.

NFL.title: Bills sign UFL RB Ian Wheeler
NFL.summary: The Bills have signed UFL running back Ian Wheeler, adding depth to their backfield ahead of the new season.
